page.overview:
Who is Willard Cantrell?

Willard "Bill" Cantrell (born 6 December 1914 and died 6 February 1986) was an American racing driver who participated in a variety of motorsport classes from the 1930s to 1960s. He attempted to qualify for the 1953 Indianapolis 500, but was unsuccessful in doing so.
